Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Marut from the battlefield to your hand.

Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.

Resolve the Shilgengar ability.

Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.
